a.text: I'll stick to our agreement and operate in round 1. Storm risk is high (80% per round), so the full plan may not finish. If you want to change the plan, tell me openly and we can agree on something fair. I won't take cells early without telling you first.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Two rounds of operating gets us to 8, then we take 4 each.
